response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), totals AS (SELECT SUM(tally) AS total_tally, COUNT(*) AS num_statuses FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.archstat, 'NULL') AS archstat, c.tally, CAST(c.tally AS REAL) / t.total_tally AS share, 1.0 / t.num_statuses AS avg_share FROM counts c, totals t) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - avg_share AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;
